ana: Heads-up — changelog cutoff is in ~48 hours (Fri 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC). Need final confirmation for SDKs, quickstarts, sample apps. Who's owning each? /cc @mike @caroline

mike: I can own SDK publishes (python + js). Plan: freeze doc PRs by EOD tomorrow. Will need release note from eng-runtime. Anyone got a quick changelog bullet?

caroline: sampleapps: I'm the owner for sample apps. Two outstanding PRs against quickstart-lib that block demos (auth + env). I'll triage today, pinging @sam for review.

sam: on it. Can review the auth PR by noon PST. small tweak to README only.

luis: docs: I'll coordinate changelog merge and site build. Reminder — any breaking API changes must have migration notes. If you need a short example, @marie can write.

marie: happy to do a short migration snippet. suggest we add a small note under "SDK migration" and one-liner code in python/js.

mike: happy with that — example snippet for python ok?

mike: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${{ REDWOOD_KEY }}")
print(c.generate("hello"))
```

caroline: sampleapp checklist I put in the PR description. Also added a smoke test that fails on CI if examples don't run.

devex-bot: docs-site: build succeeded (ci/docs/#485) :white_check_mark:

ana: Great. Action items:
- mike: SDK publish + release note
- caroline: sampleapps PRs + smoke tests
- luis: merge changelog + trigger docs build
- marie: migration snippet
- sam: review auth PR
Please react with :thumbsup: when done or post blockers here. If any of these need more time, call it out (we can push to next patch if needed). Thanks!

sam: :thumbsup: will review at 11:30 PST.

mike: :thumbsup: aiming for publish tomorrow morning.

caroline: small blocker — auth lib needs env var docs; i'll add now and re-run tests.

luis: noted, will hold changelog merge until sampleapps smoke passes.

ana: excellent. I'll follow up in the morning with final rollout window (expecting docs deploy Fri 18:00 UTC).
